GeoFlow Connector
pyqgis_plugin.description: GeoFlow project login, persistent local Snapshot reuse, cache lifecycle management, field-level Changeset synchronization, revision Delta updates, and realtime multi-user Delta hints.
pyqgis_plugin.about: GeoFlow connects project snapshots, dynamic forms, Survey imports and field Changeset synchronization. Version 1.4.3 uses spatial Survey and depth searches, active-layer-only selection, a shared 2.0m default search radius, and timed inline depth calculation feedback. Existing project radius overrides are preserved.
